programme.desc: A police-state scapegoat (Arnold Schwarzenegger) must play a TV host's (Richard Dawson) deadly game show for the 21st-century masses.

programme.title: The Hunter
programme.desc: Modern bounty hunter Ralph "Papa" Thorson (Steve McQueen) hunts fugitives for a bail bondsman (Eli Wallach).

programme.title: John Carpenter's Escape From L.A.
programme.desc: The fascist U.S. president enlists a jailed war hero (Kurt Russell) to retrieve a top-secret device stolen by his daughter on island Los Angeles in 2013.

programme.title: Old Henry
programme.desc: A quiet man and his son take in a wounded stranger near his homestead, along with a bag full of cash. The stranger claims he's a sheriff being pursued by outlaws, but the man can't be sure.

programme.title: Twisted
programme.desc: With help from her partner (Andy Garcia), a police inspector (Ashley Judd) searches for a killer who is murdering her former lovers.

programme.title: Set It Off
programme.desc: Desperation drives four inner-city women to bank robbery in Los Angeles, then they start mistrusting one another.

programme.title: The Untouchables
programme.desc: Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness attempts to take Al Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: Dead soldiers from the '60s surface in the '90s as high-tech warriors reanimated by the U.S. government.

programme.title: Approaching the Unknown
programme.desc: An American astronaut (Mark Strong) tests his will, sanity and endurance while embarking on a one-way, solo mission to Mars.

programme.title: Cloverfield
programme.desc: A group of friends venture deep into the streets of New York on a rescue mission during a rampaging monster attack.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A former Roman General sets out to exact vengeance against the corrupt emperor who murdered his family and sent him into slavery.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Investigators and reporters become obsessed with finding the serial killer terrorizing San Francisco in the late 1960s and '70s.

programme.title: The Devil Inside
programme.desc: A woman (Fernanda Andrade) recruits two young exorcists to help her determine whether her mother, who murdered three people, is mentally ill or possessed by demons.

programme.title: The House With a Clock in Its Walls
programme.desc: Ten-year-old Lewis goes to live with his uncle in a creaky old house that contains a mysterious ticktock noise. When Lewis accidentally awakens the dead, the town's sleepy facade magically springs to life with a secret world of witches and warlocks.

programme.title: Monstrous
programme.desc: A terrifying new horror awaits Laura and her 7-year-old son, Cody, when they flee her abusive ex-husband and try to settle into a new life. Still traumatized, their fragile existence is pushed to the breaking point.

programme.title: Sleepy Hollow
programme.desc: Constable Ichabod Crane is sent to the village of Sleepy Hollow, where a headless horseman is leaving a trail of decapitated bodies.

programme.title: The Survivalist
programme.desc: A year and a half after the fall of civilization due to a viral outbreak, a former FBI agent is forced to protect a young woman immune to the disease from a dangerous gang leader hunting her.

programme.title: Love and Monsters
programme.desc: A young man and his traveling companions battle an array of monsters during an epic, 80-mile journey to find the woman he loves.

programme.title: The Score
programme.desc: Two small-time crooks drive to a secluded cafe for a big score.

programme.title: Murder Company
programme.desc: During the D-Day invasion, a group of U.S. soldiers must smuggle a member of the French resistance behind enemy lines to assassinate a high-value Nazi target.

programme.title: The Comeback Trail
programme.desc: Indebted to a mobster, a desperate producer tries to "accidentally" kill an aging movie star for an insurance scam. However, he soon begins to realize that the film they're shooting is a masterpiece in the making.

programme.title: National Lampoon's Animal House
programme.desc: Bluto (John Belushi), Otter and the rowdy Deltas make fools of the dean and the square Omegas at 1962 Faber College.

programme.title: Boogie Nights
programme.desc: A producer (Burt Reynolds) guides a young man (Mark Wahlberg) to success in the 1970s porn industry, but greed and egotism lead to his downfall in the '80s.

programme.title: The Infernal Machine
programme.desc: Reclusive and controversial author Bruce Cogburn is drawn out of hiding when he begins to receive endless letters from an obsessive fan. What ensues is a dangerous labyrinth as Bruce searches for the person behind the cryptic messages.

programme.title: The Courier
programme.desc: Recruited by MI6, British businessman Greville Wynne works with Soviet spy Oleg Penkovsky to obtain intelligence on the Cuban Missile Crisis.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 5: Minnesota Timberwolves at Oklahoma City Thunder
programme.desc: Minnesota Timberwolves at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 5 of the Western Conference Finals. From Paycom Center. Up 3-1, the Thunder look to seal their first trip to the NBA Finals since 2012 after holding off Minnesota 128-126 in Game 4 behind league MVP Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's playoff career-high 40 points. OKC corralled 14 steals, contributing to the Timberwolves' 21 turnovers in the loss.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 1: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks in Game 1 of the Eastern Conference finals. From Madison Square Garden. The Knicks' first conference finals in 25 years is also their fourth in a row against Indiana, which won that 2000 series after falling in 1994 and '99. More recently, Tyrese Haliburton and the Pacers fought off the Jalen Brunson-led Knicks in seven games in the Eastern semifinals last spring after dropping the first two games at MSG.

programme.sub-title: Game 2: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks
programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at New York Knicks in Game 2 of the Eastern Conference finals. From Madison Square Garden. New York trails 1-0 after squandering the opener in overtime to a relentless Pacers squad headlined by hot-shooting Aaron Nesmith (eight threes, 30 points). Indiana erased a 14-point deficit in the final three minutes of regulation and had a 27-4 edge in points off turnovers. The Knicks are 3-4 at MSG this postseason.

programme.title: NBA Playoff
programme.sub-title: Game 3: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers
programme.desc: New York Knicks at Indiana Pacers in Game 3 of the Eastern Conference finals. Rick Carlisle's Pacers come home on Indy 500 Day looking to pull away from the Knicks after grinding out wins in the first two games in New York City. Ninth-year forward Pascal Siakam exploded for 39 points in Game 2, while Jalen Brunson's 39.5 ppg and eight assists/game have not been enough for the Knicks, who now look to build on their 5-1 road record this postseason.

programme.title: NBA Finals

programme.desc: Indiana Pacers at Oklahoma City Thunder in Game 1 of the best-of-seven NBA championship series. From Paycom Center. Tyrese Haliburton paces potent Indiana in its first Finals in 25 years, while league MVP and fellow guard Shai Gilgeous-Alexander stars for a deep, defense-minded OKC squad. The Thunder's 68 regular-season wins to Indy's 50 marks the largest difference in an NBA Finals since 1981, when Boston (62 wins) took out Houston (40) in six games.

programme.title: Ligue 1. "Marseille" - PSG
programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: Some provocative episodes from Season 5 of CSI involve Russian mail order brides (\"Nesting Dolls\"), infantism (\"King Baby\"), and the Mexican lifestyle of narcocorrido (\"Snakes\"). From the creative storytelling (\"4x4\") to the macabre (\"Who Shot Sherlock?\"), there’s something in Season 5 for everyone. The CSI team investigates many crimes that hit close to home as well. Grissom comes under fire from Ecklie (\"Mea Culpa\"), Brass tracks down his estranged daughter (\"Hollywood Brass\"), and during the course of the season Greg Sanders completes his transition from the lab to the field. Last, but not least, Season 5 wraps with an amazing two-part episode (\"Grave Danger\"), written and directed by Quentin Tarantino, where Nick comes face to face with death while the team exhausts all its resources to same him.
